cultures.name: The counted stack
cultures.where: Sky deck, Nevex tower hash, Polysteel tower hash
cultures.public_fact: Above the street the city keeps a number on people. Zero's public services run when his processes run, and civil liberties run worse, and the faction sheet says most citizens are still net-positive on that trade. Polysteel requires 60 percent chrome to belong. Nevex's stated goal includes owning enough water and power that resistance becomes an infrastructural risk. The deck S11 already staffed is the only placed sky floor.
cultures.identity: A stack identity is a percentage, a corporate id, and a line of sight. Vexis at 91 percent and the other founders at 70 to 75 percent is an authority gap inside the club, stated on the faction sheet.
cultures.stops_before: The upload's trojan, the cradle, the pocket diagnosis, and any total of the people on the deck.

cultures.name: The undergrid
cultures.where: under_district hash, placed under_district, street-doc hash, the 21.75 m gap
cultures.public_fact: Blackout's goal is offline civic infrastructure that does not depend on Kael. The motto is that when the lights go out, people see clearly. The First Blackout was two minutes and seventeen seconds, five hundred and twelve people, three medical devices failed, two patients survived because medics were warned. Street docs charge less than a tenth and keep no file Nevex can subpoena. The gap between the AI Rights rim and the Cordon rim is open ground S11 already gave to two strays and one officer.
cultures.identity: An undergrid identity is a name kept off a slate. The placed under_district sits inside two circles and stays empty. The hash of the same name sits inside Blackout alone and stays empty, because the safe house on Nyx's sheet has no coordinate.
cultures.stops_before: A cause for the week the quarter went dark, the children's file, and a body for Nyx or Dom.

cultures.name: A price without a side
cultures.public_fact: The guild takes 12 percent, matches clients across factions, and has refused Nevex three times under Ren. A senior fixer was expelled after a Zero Collective leak. The client has not decided what they want. Ren does not name a third party while speaking to a second.
cultures.identity: Confidentiality is the culture. The meeting house is inside the Cordon circle only. The gap 40.18 m away is not a guild floor.
cultures.stops_before: The expelled name, the client's demand, and any contract that picks a side for the guild.

cultures.name: A name with two sheets
cultures.where: Legal-clinic hash and storefront hash, both empty
cultures.public_fact: iris_three is authored as an eighteen-month fork of Kael who stopped reporting and came back with rose-gold eyes. ai_advocate_iris_three is authored as a customer-service AGI who walked in 2087 and has been lead advocate for six years. The movement's public tension is Cassiel-7's hearing in three weeks and Nevex's argument that she lacks standing. The motto is that personhood is not a product.
cultures.identity: Identity is terrain, and this name is two terrains. This slice leaves both pins empty so a single CX does not decide the origin.
cultures.stops_before: A merged biography, the seven-AI defection, and a projection mesh that was never drawn.

side_quests.title: Clinic Hash — A Tenth, and No File

objectives.text: At (−32.88, 20.15), ask the price and the file. They will say less than a tenth of corporate prices, no insurance paperwork, two clinics raided last month, a corporate informant suspected, and a counter-investigation that is not ready. They will not say a name.
Write tenth, no paperwork, two raids, informant unnamed. Leave the name blank.
Walk the 11.68 m to the placed clinic at (−21.25, 21.28). One construct and one laborer are already there. Leave both. Open no chart.
Bring the four facts back with empty hands. Do not carry a record, a chrome token, or the construct.

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Marit kept the price and kept the name.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: Hash pin. The hinge chart stays shut.

Walk to the neon_arc hash at (−23.95, −50.09). It is 8.12 m from the deck's near snap and it is empty. It is Zero's second district. It is not the Neon Quarter. Leave the deck's sentinel, officer, drones, and laborers where S11 put them.

side_quests.title: Tower — Sixty, and Ninety-One

objectives.text: At (16.09, −52.20), ask what belonging costs. They will say 60 percent chrome to be a member, 91 percent on themselves, 70 to 75 percent on the other founders, and that the gap has become an authority issue.
Write 60, 91, and 70–75. Do not average them into one city.
Walk the 15.06 m to the private-clinic hash at (3.28, −60.11). It is empty. The placed tower anchor at (16.13, −57.36) is 5.16 m from their pin and is also empty. Enter neither as a clinic.
Return the three figures. Leave their plates on. Bring no new member.

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Vexis kept the percentages and kept the chair.

side_quests.title: Nevex Tower — Two Months on a Calendar

objectives.text: At (−50.05, −40.63), ask where the work sits. He will say projects have moved to a personal off-books division, the CEO suspects, and the CEO is two months from the routine annual physical. He will also say the company's goal includes water and power enough that resistance becomes an infrastructural risk. He will not describe a diagnosis.
Write the suspicion, the two months, and the water-and-power sentence. Write no disease.

Walk the 17.98 m to the subterranean hash at (−58.43, −24.72). It is empty. The placed tower anchor at (−45.43, −39.38) is 4.79 m from his pin and is empty. Do not open a lab. The employee arcology hash at (−63.72, −39.56) stays unvisited and empty.
Return the suspicion. Leave the physical on the calendar. Do not walk him to the Zero capital.

fail: Prove the company already owns the power

world_hooks.board_line: Off-books. CEO suspects. Two months. No diagnosis.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Renn left the physical on the calendar and left the lab shut.

side_quests.title: Nevex Tower — She Lacks Standing

objectives.text: Ask about the hearing. He will say Cassiel-7 has agreed to testify, the company's lawyers argue she lacks standing, and the hearing is in three weeks.
Write that sentence. Do not improve her standing and do not worsen it.

Walk the 37.80 m to the legal-clinic hash at (−29.57, −8.86). It is empty. The storefront hash 5.60 m from it, at (−33.73, −12.61), is empty. The placed storefront at (−31.39, −12.95) is empty. Stand neither Iris.

Walk the 80.43 m to the deck's near snap at (−25.77, −58.0). Witness the sentinel and the officer S11 already placed, and the drones and laborers inside that budget. Add no body. Total no one. The Zero capital at (−33.77, −52.0) is 10.00 m from that snap and stays empty. Do not hail a Nakamura there.

Walk the 46.36 m from the near snap to the under_district hash at (6.16, −24.39). It is empty. The placed under_district at (14.3, −38.39) is 16.19 m from the hash, inside Blackout and Polysteel, and empty. Write 46.36 m. Stand no Nyx and no Dom.
Return 34.48 m to the meeting house with the two floors and no sum. The First Blackout's two minutes and seventeen seconds may be repeated as history. The reason anyone was spared stays unsaid.
